purpose: Actual startup implementation phase: original complete paired tool records from first final authorization read, complete raw logs including failures/superseded candidates, packaged engine raw stdin/stdout/stderr and static asar/resource bindings. No GUI/Electron handler/native/CI/double-review claim.
selectionBoundary: Only complete original tool call/output pairs are copied. Incoming messages without matching local calls and the still-running archive capture call are excluded. Exact original per-line byte offsets, lengths and SHA256 bind to the captured source prefixes; nothing is reconstructed from summaries.
